title: pure scaling, frames at 800 and 2000 px
note: As in A-Rozum/prastora: the canvas is the window in every frame, so there are no margins and text grows with the window inside each frame.

title: slowed growth: the canvas grows by half of the window, the rest is margin
note: Each frame starts edge to edge; past its start the canvas takes a share of each new pixel and the margins take the rest, so text keeps growing, more slowly, and the margins widen gradually.

title: capped growth: the canvas stops at a width, beyond it only margins grow
note: The canvas follows the window up to a cap in each frame, then holds; text never exceeds the size it has at the cap.

title: late landscape: the upright composition up to 1100 px
note: Tablets held upright and narrow windows keep the upright composition, capped so text stays moderate; the landscape composition begins where its text is no smaller than 15 px.
